what: Live check of the semantic cache on the deployed service (Cloud Run revision sentinel-api-00011-sfh, commit af3fa86, in-memory backend), 2026-11-17. Four questions in a row as the demo account: a fresh one, the exact repeat, a rewording, and a near-miss that changes one exact term (DoT -> DoH).
how: python scripts/cache_live_check.py --project <gcp-project>: wall_s measured by the client over the internet; request_ms and cost_usd from the service's own query log events in Cloud Logging.
